name: Zoology and Physiology PhD
detailsNote: Official information available; the February 1 and September 15 dates are printed without a year, so no Fall 2027 deadline is confirmed. No application fee or English minimum is stated on the pages opened.
summary: PhD in zoology and physiology at the University of Wyoming. Applicants must find a faculty member willing to be their advisor, and the department only accepts students who will have financial support.

publishedDeadlines.label: Summer/autumn admission
publishedDeadlines.note: Deadline for receipt of all application materials; no year printed.

publishedDeadlines.label: January admission
publishedDeadlines.note: Deadline for receipt of all application materials; no year printed.

english.note: International students must include a copy of their TOEFL scores. No minimum score is stated.

requirements.note: A minimum undergraduate GPA of 3.00 (A = 4.00) is required. The department cannot consider applications unless a faculty member has indicated willingness to serve as the student's advisor.

funding.note: Support is a teaching assistantship, research assistantship or fellowship, all of which pay living expenses and cover tuition and fees. The FAQ says: "We only accept students that will have some type of financial support." No stipend amount is given.

international.note: Additional information is required for international applicants.
